title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Blue Razz 10ml Nic salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Blue Razz Nic Salt E-Liquid takes the legendary Pinkman profile and adds a sharp, fruity twist. This blend starts with the iconic Pinkman base of sweet Red Berries (featuring prominent Strawberry and Raspberry notes with subtle zesty Citrus hints) and infuses it with the bold, tangy taste of Blue Raspberry. The addition of Blue Razz adds a "slushy" style sharpness that cuts through the sweeter red berry foundation. It creates a complex, multi-layered fruit vape that balances sweetness with a distinct, refreshing tang, making it an exciting alternative to the original recipe. Formulated as a Nicotine Salt, this 10ml e-liquid delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, mirroring the sensation of smoking more closely than standard freebase nicotine. With a balanced 50VG/50PG ratio, it is perfectly optimised for use in low-powered starter kits and pod vape devices.
